findings: The time-off operation mutated in-memory state and claimed submission and manager notification.
The source decided parental and remote-work eligibility from profile fields and estimated benefit value from a title-based salary assumption.
Time-off dates depended on the runtime clock, preventing deterministic review.
Live strict isolation showed that the vacation-preview wording could route to a non-preview HR operation and omit the required draft-only markers.
fixes: Converted time off to a deterministic draft preview with user-supplied dates and no mutation or notification.
Removed salary inference and individualized eligibility decisions; added explicit sensitive-circumstance and HR-decision boundaries.
Labeled all profiles and policy values as fictional synthetic evidence.
Made vacation/date preview wording explicitly route to submit_time_off and documented its deterministic Not Submitted, Draft for employee review, and no-notification contract.
remaining_boundary: Production connections and all external actions require customer approval, least-privilege controls, and an authorized human workflow.
